remarks: Somewhere between the energy of Hollywood and the serenity of the hills, a captivating modern hideaway awaits. Tucked behind gates in the coveted Hollywood Dell, this newer-construction architectural residence, completed in 2023, unfolds across four thoughtfully designed levels and is a study in contrasts: dramatic yet inviting, sophisticated yet effortlessly relaxed, and wonderfully connected to the city while feeling a world away. Step inside and discover soaring ceilings, sun-drenched interiors, warm wood floors, and walls of glass that blur the boundaries between indoors and out.
